import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Source1_70_0
# Columns: ['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_status', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_approved_at',
#           'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1: Source1_70_1
# Columns: ['order_id', 'order_item_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation plan:
# - Target schema: ['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']
# - Source0 contains order_id, order_status, order_approved_at (among others)
# - Source1 contains order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value (among others)
# - Join Source0 and Source1 on 'order_id' to get all target columns
# - There may be multiple order_item_id per order_id in Source1, so join will produce multiple rows per order_id if multiple items exist
# - No aggregation needed because target examples show multiple rows per order_id (with different product_id, seller_id)
# - Ensure data types match target schema:
#     * order_id, order_status, order_approved_at, product_id, seller_id as string (object)
#     * price, freight_value as float
# - Some columns may have missing values; keep as is (no aggregation or filtering specified)
# - Export the final dataframe to the specified path

# Perform inner join on 'order_id'
df_merged = pd.merge(df0[['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at']], 
                     df1[['order_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']],
                     on='order_id',
                     how='inner')

# Ensure correct data types
df_merged['order_id'] = df_merged['order_id'].astype(str)
df_merged['order_status'] = df_merged['order_status'].astype(str)
df_merged['order_approved_at'] = df_merged['order_approved_at'].astype(str)
df_merged['product_id'] = df_merged['product_id'].astype(str)
df_merged['seller_id'] = df_merged['seller_id'].astype(str)
df_merged['price'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['price'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
df_merged['freight_value'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['freight_value'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_target = df_merged[['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']]

# Write the result to the specified CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
